---
title: "Inputs"
---

There are two main inputs to Flower:

-   The `datapackage.json` file, which is the machine-readable JSON file
    that is the foundation of a [Data Package](https://datapackage.org).
    This file contains metadata on the package (like title, description,
    and contributors) as well as metadata on the data resources (like
    column names, data types, descriptions, and a path to the file with
    the data).

-   The configuration settings, either provided as command-line
    arguments, through a Python class, or contained within a file.
